scanWindow.recentListWindow: 本轮分页读取 2026-08-27 的五个官方 recent 列表，并按 arXiv ID 跨类别归并。
scanWindow.boundaryNote: 方向查询向前扩到 8 月 23 日，用于覆盖上期简报生成后才完成审核或进入 recent 列表的稿件；候选与 reported-papers 去重，扫描窗口不等同作者提交日期。

queryRuns.searchQuery: (all:"cooperative driving" OR all:"cooperative perception" OR all:V2X OR all:"vehicle-to-everything") AND submittedDate:[202608230000 TO 202608272359]
(all:"driving world model" OR (all:"world model" AND all:driving) OR all:"driving scene representation") AND submittedDate:[202608230000 TO 202608272359]
((all:"autonomous driving" OR all:"driving policy") AND (all:test OR all:evaluation OR all:safety OR all:accident OR all:robustness)) AND submittedDate:[202608230000 TO 202608272359]

rubric.rule: 八项等权；不按方向配额补齐。正式状态、代码和数据可用性、作者单位、数字及图源在入选后重新核验。

candidates.title: Scaling Curriculum Learning For Autonomous Driving
candidates.reason: 1k、10k、80k 场景和受限算力消融支持 curriculum 样本效率，且代码仓库有实际实现；报告同时保留 realism 下降边界。

candidates.title: Waveform Design for Simultaneous MIMO Radar Sensing and Multi-User Communication
candidates.reason: 核心是 MIMO radar/communication 波形优化，没有道路场景表示、占据或驾驶规划终点。

candidates.title: ISAC Beamforming Design Based on a Matrix Nearness Formulation With Improved Efficiency
candidates.reason: 通用 ISAC beamforming 数值优化，不属于车载雷达占据或驾驶场景表征。

candidates.title: LoViF 2026 The First Challenge on Unified Removal of Raindrops and Reflections: Methods and Results
candidates.reason: 真实 RDRF 数据和严格单帧重跑有价值，但 test 只有 55 scenes、参赛预算不一致，且没有检测、规划或驾驶安全收益；评分 7.1 未过线。

candidates.title: Dual-Orthogonality Waveforms for Integrated Communication and Imaging in Dynamic Multipath Channels
candidates.reason: 研究通信成像波形与多径信道，没有道路 ODD、occupancy 或下游驾驶任务。

candidates.title: MomADv2: Reliable Temporal Memory for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
candidates.reason: 命令一致性、时间连续性和轨迹对齐的逐级消融直接检验可靠记忆，数字不一致和配置混写在报告中显式保留。

candidates.title: RIS-Assisted Radar-Communication Coexistence: Detection Analysis with Channel Uncertainties
candidates.reason: RIS radar-communication coexistence分析，不涉及车载场景状态或自动驾驶评价。

candidates.title: GeoWAM: Visual Geometry World Action Models for Autonomous Driving
candidates.reason: 未来点图预测与 NAVSIM 规划形成明确表示到动作接口，并保留无消融、pseudo-closed-loop 和视频基线二次重建混杂。

candidates.title: SceneReGen: Generative Reconstruction of 3D Scenes from a Single Image
candidates.reason: 定量实验集中在室内 3D-FUTURE，自动驾驶仅有定性示例，没有道路场景指标或规划效用。

candidates.title: SIREN-Bench: Behavior-Driven Generation and Evaluation of Emergency-Vehicle Interactions
candidates.reason: 行为级 SUMO-CARLA 生成同时暴露检测、预测和风险理解失败；单地图、单 episode 和未发布资产限制已记录。

candidates.title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Real-Time Generative Physics Simulation for Surgical Robotics
candidates.reason: 面向手术机器人和组织物理，不属于道路驾驶世界模型。

candidates.title: Compressive Sensing - Introduction and Relations to Deep Learning
candidates.reason: 压缩感知综述仅将 radar 作为通用应用示例，不是驾驶论文。

candidates.title: CARE: Camera-Residual Reserves for First Sightings in Adaptive LiDAR Sensing
candidates.reason: 泄漏隔离的首次发现协议、配对区间、实车序列和 CARLA 闭环构成多层证据，同时诚实显示整体 mAP/NDS 不总提升。

candidates.title: Resource Allocation for Secure Dual-UAV-Assisted ISAC System
candidates.reason: UAV-assisted secure ISAC 资源分配，与道路自动驾驶场景表示无关。

candidates.title: Non-minimally coupled Weyl connection gravity in the Solar System and at the Galactic Center
candidates.reason: 引力与天体观测论文，radar 只是词面命中。

candidates.title: Neurosymbolic Alignment for Physiologically-Safe Clinical Language Models
candidates.reason: 临床语言模型安全对齐，不是驾驶 world model；driving 为检索词误命中。

candidates.title: SkyDrive: Learning to Drive in a New City from Aerial Traffic Monitoring
candidates.reason: 137.2 小时 aerial monitoring、规划与预测双任务和数据量消融支持低成本城市适配，派生资产未发布与单城边界已记录。

candidates.title: Simulating Cognitive Smart Freight Corridors with Agent-Based Models and Reinforcement Learning
candidates.reason: 终点是智能货运走廊的 agent-based logistics/control policy，不是自动驾驶协同感知、预测或车辆规划。

candidates.title: BeamGuard: Risk-Aware Multimodal Beam Forecasting and Adaptive Virtual Beamwidth Control for 6G mmWave V2I Links
candidates.reason: 虽涉及 V2I 与多模态 sensing，任务终点是通信 beam management，没有场景占据、驾驶状态或规划效用。

candidates.title: WaveOp-LiteFM: Lightweight Neural-Operator Flow Matching for Satellite-to-Radar Precipitation Retrieval
candidates.reason: 卫星到气象雷达降水反演，与车载 radar scene representation 无关。

candidates.title: DESCENT: Directed Edge Scene Encoding for Airport Surface Movement Prediction
candidates.reason: 机场地面航空器预测借用自动驾驶方法，但任务、拓扑和 ODD 不属于道路驾驶配置。

candidates.title: Optical extinction and near-field properties of plasmonic dimers: Role of particle shape and separation
candidates.reason: 等离激元光学论文，与 radar 词面匹配但无驾驶关联。

candidates.title: Gating Before Commitment: Anticipating Intent Divergence to Prevent Post-Interaction Decision Failures in Autonomous Driving
candidates.reason: commitment 前门控、预注册失败、matched-FP 负消融和 OOD 高误报共同形成窄而透明的安全机制证据。

independentReview.firstReviewFinding: 首次终审发现 SkyDrive Figure 4 将 sharp-turn 误写为掉头，并发现 Radar Occupancy 趋势正文引用 CARE 但证据数组未绑定；发布前已修正。
independentReview.finalFinding: 两项阻断问题均已修复：SkyDrive Figure 4 分类与原文一致，Radar Occupancy 趋势的标签和证据 ID 与 CARE 引用一致且维持四项上限；本期发布证据边界与内部关联完整。
